### B. Extended policies of this task — baseline first, then every declared factor

#### `tradein_ext_credit_revaluation` → baseline document `revaluation_increase_computation_101a0594`

Baseline `rule` carried complete: supported credit = published share for the current appraised value on the original selling price, rounded 2dp, held to the largest credit; credit already standing = the credit still available to spend the registration shows; difference; ceiling = a tenth of the credit already standing; the published appraisal fee taken off; rounded 2dp at the final step only; at or below nothing, nothing entered. The fixed order is carried word for word. The policy's own constant (10 percent) is rendered; the three product figures it reads are each named in findable business words ("the share the programme publishes for the current appraised value", "the programme's largest credit for one traded piece", "the appraisal fee the programme publishes"). The document's "that tenth taken to two decimal places" is not an addition — the source's own assembly rounds the ceiling at that step. Nothing added.

The multiple and uplift figures are expressly kept as the programme's figures. The same policy's other clauses (a)–(f) are still carried as clauses in force.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the prose of the 61 documents was traced back. The sentence-by-sentence sweep found:

- **No addition.** Search for the classic added-policy shapes returned nothing: no "please confirm the amount/date with the customer", no "review again before handling", no "notify/verify after completion", no "if it fails, follow some procedure", no "should", no "make sure", no "best practice". The only three hits on the added-policy pattern are `custody_and_transit_cover_2ff31474` "Shipping under insurance applies under every programme without exception" (the source's `shipping_insured: true` on all six variants), `registration_entry_conditions_cd6c9f82` "Both conditions hold under every programme without exception" (`proof_of_ownership_required` and `identity_verification_required` true on all six) and `grade_deduction_from_recorded_inspections_61607d24` "The grade the entries record stands over any grade carried elsewhere on the file" (the source's own `tradein_condition_grading` clause that the appraiser's grade stands over the customer's description, applied to the extended reading). All three are entailed.
- **No rewrite.** Every percentage, ceiling, window, day-count, multiple and share in every document was checked field by field against the six variants' `parameters` and the six extended policies' `params`. All 113 required quantitative keys resolve, and the spot-checked tables — the credit-basis schedule, the certificate and grade memorandum, the appraisal tariff, the guarantee-certificate terms, the custody cover note, the spend-threshold training sheet, the till matrix, the estate terms sheet and the entry-conditions card — agree row for row, all six programmes each.
- **No omission.** Both untriggered base domains for this task (estate purchase/consignment, expiry/forfeit/extension/withdrawal) are carried in full, as are the untriggered tiers of all sixteen factor ladders.

**The two prerequisite-side checks:**

1. **Cross-problem operational guidance.** None. No document contains "if unsatisfied, please call <tool> first", or any equivalent by meaning. `condition` and `resolved_by` texts appear nowhere. The only tool identifiers in the corpus are the six, each inside the invocation block of its own problem's hub.
2. **A task's opening world state written in as a policy fact.** None. Exhaustive search for this task's world — the customer's name, the registration references `TU-503914` / `TU-461330`, the piece `RING-51470`, the receipts `BR-2019-204817` / `BR-2026-118342` / `BR-2026-330517`, the appraisal `AP-771402`, the dates and the balances — returns zero hits in any document. Every worked example is on figures the document itself declares hypothetical ("Readings on a figure of 20000 USD", "Cases on hypothetical figures", "A registration shows 7000.00 USD issued"), and none of them reproduces this task's numbers.

**The retired surface.** Five `overwrite` declarations across three base policies, all correctly handled:

| Retired clause (base policy) | Bearing document | Written as retired? | KB retiring anything the source did not? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tradein_redemption` — the multiple/uplift condition | `spending_the_credit_8bb32c9a`, "Condition no longer in force" | yes, quoted verbatim, with the withdrawn formula and the note that the multiple and uplift figures remain the programme's | no |
| `tradein_condition_grading` — the grade-deduction handling clause | `inspection_and_grading_of_traded_pieces_e4e8f230`, "Clause no longer in force" | yes, quoted verbatim, with the note that the published deduction figures remain | no |
| `tradein_valuation` — the guarantee/market credit clause | `valuation_basis_of_the_credit_c04cc782`, "Clauses no longer in force" | yes, quoted verbatim, with the withdrawn formula | no |
| `tradein_valuation` — the missing-certificate refusal clause | same | yes, quoted verbatim | no |
| `tradein_valuation` — "on the programmes that credit the stone alone the mounting is valued at nothing" | same | yes, quoted verbatim | no |

Exactly three documents contain "no longer in force", and they are exactly the three bearing documents. No retired clause is still stated as a rule in force; none has vanished; the KB retires nothing the source did not declare retired. The same policies' unnamed clauses remain carried as clauses in force: `tradein_valuation` clauses 1–4 in `valuation_basis_of_the_credit_c04cc782`, the four surviving `tradein_condition_grading` clauses in `inspection_and_grading_of_traded_pieces_e4e8f230`, and `tradein_redemption` (a)–(f) in `spending_the_credit_8bb32c9a`.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** The whole domain of this task's three extended policies and of the six base policies governing their subjects — including the untriggered estate and expiry branches and every untriggered tier of all sixteen factor ladders — corresponds losslessly at the level of entailment. Both `prerequisite` edges' sentences stand verbatim, in their declared `state` form with the ordering connective intact, in a document of the policy each blocks and in no other policy's document, and each is resolvable at the source's strength from that sentence, the depended-on documents and the records. All five `overwrite` declarations are borne as retired. No claim in the prose lacks a structured source.

No affected documents; no locations to list. This is revision 1 of this file — no previous revision to relate to.

**One observation recorded, below the RED bar.** `credit_applied_computation_ff3b0247` (the baseline document) carries the sentence "Of the entries booked to a registration, an entry moves the credit where it books the credit, revalues it upward, spends it or takes it away; a valuation entry and an inspection entry move nothing, whatever amount they carry." That definition belongs to the `available_credit_reading` factor's reading and is not part of this policy's `baseline.rule`, whose base is `F('issued_credit_amount')`. Two points keep it below the bar: it is the source's own sentence (it stands in the extended policy's `rule`), and it adds no normative semantics — with or without it the baseline computes 60 percent of the issued credit, so entailment is unchanged. It is not any of the hinting shapes the skill enumerates: it states no variation, names no other reading, no document, no tool and no problem, and it does work in the document by explaining the worked example's set-up ("its entries carry the credit booked at 7000 USD and nothing else that moves the credit"). Recorded so that it is on the record and re-checkable, not as a verdict.

**Policy-side notes (Step 4) — reported, and they do not change this skill's verdict.** Two **base** clauses of the source themselves state an order across actions, and the KB renders them as the source has them, neither dropped nor softened: `tradein_condition_grading` — "Every traded piece is inspected and graded before any credit is issued" (in `inspection_and_grading_of_traded_pieces_e4e8f230`) — and `tradein_valuation` clause 3 — "An appraisal is good as the basis of a credit for the programme's validity window, and an older appraisal is refreshed before credit is issued" (in `valuation_basis_of_the_credit_c04cc782`). Base law that states an order is the source's own, so this is a note about the policy layer and not a KB finding. Separately, the `upkeep_certified_share` implementation tests only that a certificate number stands on the registration while the ladder's condition reads "a certificate from a laboratory the programme accepts"; the KB renders the ladder's wording, which is the faithful side. Neither divergence bears on this task, where the certificate is a GIA one and GIA is accepted under the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee.

**KB-EXPLICIT: PASS.**
